scope: Registered internal H1 saved-data comparison; no simulation, physical identification, grid convergence or validation.

reusedDefinitions.changes: Exact HIL roster selection; frozen Dnew, D0 and D0..2D0 requests; coverage checked before old window helper; same independent endpoint-difference arithmetic.

definitions.increments: Subtract inherited event state for each history. Spans in cells; multiply by dxUm=.35 for micrometres. Occupied sites are not total accreted mass.
definitions.windows: One Dnew over all six histories. Fixed D0 evaluated separately; no overlong window is clamped. Static controls do not set Dnew.
definitions.brackets: At-or-before plus next-event alternatives; exact event times use only exact state. Bounds are stage sensitivity, not statistical error.
definitions.controls: Source static origin is actual history event age; destination starts fresh at age0 and is context, not a matched state counterfactual.
